blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.
blocks.zh: 决策模型用一个打字输出来回答一个问题,比如在选项中进行选择,每个选项都有概率,所以一个模型可以选择代理人的行动,评价已经采取的行动,或者对每个动作进行评分,以强化学习来教导一个政策. 先前的工作主要是作为行为者对他们进行研究,根据他们的行动程度判断他们的用处。 我们问一个行为不良的决定模式是否能够继续教好。 我们比较了三个决定模型和三个普通法学硕士作为ALFWorld的演员和评委,并使用JEV作为ALFWorld和WebShop的老师. 作为行动者,所有六种模式都脱离了一个次级目标,而次级目标必须先于一个较容易的目标。 法官们看到整个轨迹,同样的模式赞扬为实现这一次级目标所采取的步骤,并询问每项行动是否都有助益,而不是任务能否成功,这与无用的行动是分开的。 作为教师,JEV将GRPO的Qwen2.5-1.5B政策从ALFWorld的72.8%提高到82.9%,在WebShop上从56.8%提高到71.4%。 这些结果表明,一个贫穷的演员仍然能够很好地教书,因为在剧集结束后对某一行动进行判断,揭示了演员必须预见的后果. 代码见https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Decision models are pretrained models that answer a question about a context with a typed output, such as a choice among given options with a probability for each, instead of generated text, and they do so quickly and cheaply ( Almeida, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ; Perplexity AI, 2026 ) . An LLM agent can therefore query the same decision model in two ways: to choose its next action, or to evaluate an action that has already been taken. Its evaluations can in turn teach a policy during reinforcement learning, by scoring each action of every rollout. This use matters because outcome rewards give every action in a trajectory the same credit ( Harutyunyan et al., 2019 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) , while step-level judgments are otherwise costly, requiring labels for each environment ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) or an LLM judge queried at every action ( Tan et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) . Yet decision models have been evaluated mainly as actors ( Zhu et al., 2026b ; Ling et al., 2026 ) , and in that role they often fail: they are drawn to commands that mention task objects, skip prerequisite subgoals, and complete subgoals in the wrong order ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Ling et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 决策模型是预先训练的模型,用来回答一个带有打字输出的上下文问题,比如在给定选项中选择一个每个选项的概率,而不是生成文本,它们快速和廉价地这样做(Almeida, 2026; OpenAI, 2026; Perplexity AI, 2026). 因此,一个LLM代理人可以通过两种方式询问同一个决定模式:选择其下一步行动,或者评价已经采取的行动. 其评价可以在强化学习期间通过评分每次推出的每项行动来传授一项政策。 这种使用很重要,因为结果奖励给轨迹中的每一项行动都以同样的功劳(Harutyunyan等人,2019年;Shao等人,2024年),而阶梯级判决则代价高昂,需要为每一种环境打上标签(Lightman等人,2024年),或由LLM法官对每一项行动提出质询(Tan等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2026年a年)。 然而,决策模式主要被评价为行为者(Zhu et al.,2026b;Ling等人,2026年),在这种作用中往往失败:它们被引向提及任务对象的命令,跳过先决条件次级目标,按错误顺序完成次级目标(Yang等人,2026年;Ling等人,2026年;Ling等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: These failures do not settle how useful a decision model is when it evaluates rather than acts. On the same ALFWorld evaluation tasks, JEV completes 42.9% of the tasks when it chooses the actions itself. When it instead scores every action of a 1.5B policy during training, after seeing the whole trajectory, the policy completes 82.9% of the tasks if JEV is asked whether each action helped achieve the goal, compared with 72.8% for training with outcome rewards alone. Asked instead whether the task will succeed after each action, JEV yields a policy that completes only 69.3%. The same model can thus act poorly yet teach well, but only when it is asked the right question. This paper asks why a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well, and which queries make this possible .
blocks.zh: 这些失败并不能解决决策模式在评价而不是行为时的用处。 在相同的ALFWorld评价任务上,JEV在自己选择动作时完成42.9%的任务. 当在培训期间对1.5B政策的每一行动进行评分时,在看到整个轨迹后,如果问JEV是否每项行动都有助于实现目标,则该政策完成82.9%的任务,而仅培训成果奖励就达到72.8%。 被问及任务是否会在每次行动后成功, JEV 给出的政策只完成69.3%。 因此,同一模式可以表现不佳,但教得却很好,但只有在问到正确问题时。 本文询问为什么不良行为的决策模式仍然能教好,

blocks.en: We answer these questions by querying the same decision models in each way on the same tasks (Figure 1 ). As an Actor , a model chooses each action before seeing its effect. As a Judge , it evaluates actions in recorded trajectories, and we vary two choices: what it sees, either the trajectory up to the action ( Prefix ) or the whole trajectory ( Hindsight ), and what it is asked, either whether the task will succeed after the action ( Value ) or whether the action helped achieve the goal ( Progress ). As a Teacher , it applies the same queries to the actions of a policy being trained, and its scores, centered within each rollout group, are added to the outcome advantage of GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Each analysis changes one factor, such as the goal, the question, or the context, and holds the rest fixed. We evaluate three decision models and three general LLMs given the same questions, two of them the base LLMs of decision models, on ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) and WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , where some subgoals must be completed in order.
blocks.zh: 在回答这些问题时,我们以各种方式就相同的任务询问相同的决定模式(图1)。 作为演员,一个模型在看到每个动作的效果之前都会选择每个动作. 作为一名法官,它评价记录轨迹中的行为,我们有两种选择:它所看到的,直至动作的轨迹(前缀)或整个轨迹(平视),以及它被问到的问题,无论是在动作(价值)后任务是否成功,还是动作是否有助于实现目标(进步). 作为一名教师,它将同样的询问应用于正在培训的政策行动,其分数以每个推出组为中心,加入GRPO的成果优势(Shao等人,2024年)。 每项分析都会改变一个因素,如目标,问题,或上下文,并保持其余的固定. 我们评价了三个决定模式和三个一般有限责任方案,提出了同样的问题,其中两个是决定模式的基本有限责任方案,分别涉及ALFWorld(Shridhar等人,2021年)和WebShop(姚等人,2022年),其中某些次级目标必须按顺序完成。

blocks.en: Figure 1: One decision model queried in three ways, on the task of putting a heated mug on a table. Actor : choosing the next action. Judge : scoring an action of a recorded trajectory under two contexts (Prefix, Hindsight) and two questions (Value, Progress). Teacher : scoring the actions of policy rollouts, with the centered scores added to the GRPO outcome advantage. The middle row lists the six models we evaluate.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 一种决定模式以三种方式询问将一个热杯子放在桌上的任务。 演员:选择下一个动作. 法官:在两个上下文(Prefix, Hindsight)和两个问题(Value, Progress)下评分记录轨迹的动作. 老师:评分政策推出行动,中心分数加盟GRPO成果优势. 中行列出我们评价的六个模型.

blocks.en: All six models succeed far less often when one subgoal must be completed before another, such as heating a mug before placing it on a table; JEV, for example, completes 70.8% of tasks with two independent subgoals but only 14.7% of tasks with ordered ones. The models do not lack knowledge of the required step. In states where a single action would complete the easier subgoal, removing that subgoal from the goal moves most of each model’s probability to the required step; for JEV, the probability on the required state change rises from 14.6% to 77.6%. A reminder about the dependency changes success by only − 2.8 % -2.8\% to + 5.2 % +5.2\% . To act correctly, the model must anticipate that the easier action leaves the task incomplete before any consequence is visible, whereas a judge evaluates the action after its consequences have occurred.
blocks.zh: 当一个次级目标必须比另一个次级目标完成时,所有六个模式的成功率都低得多,例如在将一个杯子放在桌子上之前加热杯子;例如,JEV以两个独立的次级目标完成70.8%的任务,但只有14.7%的任务有订购的目标。 这些模型并不缺乏对所需步骤的了解。 在单一行动能够完成较容易的次级目标的情况下,将该次级目标从目标中去除,将每个模型的大部分概率移到所要求的步骤;对JEV来说,所需状态变化的概率从14.6%上升到77.6%。 对依赖性的提醒仅将成功率 − 2.8% - 2.8 + + 5.2% + 5.2 + = 。 为了正确行事,模型必须预见,较容易的行动会在任何后果明显之前就使任务完成,而法官则在行动的后果发生之后对行动进行评价。

blocks.en: Seeing the whole trajectory helps Judges recognize contributions that the same models overlook as Actors: these contributions can be unclear from the prefix alone but become apparent from what follows. Seeing the consequences is not enough, however. With the whole trajectory visible, asking whether each action helped separates actions that complete a subgoal from actions that change nothing, with JEV scoring the former 0.36 higher within a trajectory, whereas asking whether the task will succeed gives a gap of only 0.05, because every action in the trajectory then has the same answer, the outcome. All six models show both effects, and the two decision models with a disclosed base LLM judge more accurately than that LLM given the same question, at 28% to 43% lower cost per score.
blocks.zh: 观察整个轨迹有助于法官认识到同一模式忽略的作为行为者的贡献:这些贡献从前缀本身可能不清楚,但从下文可以看出来。 然而,看到后果是不够的。 整个轨迹可见,询问每项行动是否有助于将完成一个次级目标的行动与没有改变的行动区分开来,JEV在轨迹中将前者的分数提高0.36,而询问任务是否成功只能产生0.05的差距,因为轨迹中的每一项行动都有一个相同的答案,就是结果。 所有6种模型都显示了这两种效果,两个具有披露基LLM判断力的决定模型比LLM给出的相同问题更准确,每分28%到43%的成本更低.

blocks.en: The question and context that judge best also teach best. The ALFWorld result above holds on WebShop, where JEV’s Progress scores with the whole trajectory raise success from 56.8% with outcome rewards alone to 71.4%, against 68.3% with the Value question, and the 1.5B policy taught this way outperforms a 7B policy trained with outcome rewards alone on both environments. With only the prefix visible, the two questions perform similarly. The gains are largest on the ALFWorld tasks with ordered subgoals, where the policy completes 86.8%, 6.9% to 16.2% more than with the other questions and contexts, although JEV completes only 14.7% of these tasks as an actor.
blocks.zh: 法官最擅长的问题和背景。 上面的ALFWorld结果在WebShop上占据了地位,JEV进步的得分与整个轨迹相比,成功率从56.8%,结果回报率单是71.4%,而价值问题为68.3%,1.5B政策以此方式超越了仅受过结果回报的7B政策。 由于只有前缀可见,两个问题表现相似. ALFWorld任务获得的收益最大,其次级目标是:政策完成86.8%,比其他问题和背景增加6.9%至16.2%,尽管JEV作为行动者只完成14.7%。

blocks.en: Taken together, these results suggest that a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate . This benefit requires asking about each action rather than about the outcome, and it is largest for the actions the model handles worst as an actor, those whose value depends on what follows. Two implications follow for using decision models, and possibly other frozen judges, in agent training. First, a model’s suitability as a supervisor should be assessed by how well it judges recorded trajectories, not only by how well it acts. Second, step-level supervision can be obtained cheaply by querying a frozen decision model after each episode, without step labels or a learned critic, for 22 to 30 USD of queries per training run in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,不良行为的决策模式仍然可以很好地教人,因为在剧情结束后对某一行动进行判断,揭示了行动必须预见的后果。 这种好处需要询问每个行动,而不是结果,对于模型作为行为者处理的最糟糕的行动,其价值取决于随后的情况,是最大的。 在代理人培训中,使用裁决模式,以及可能使用其他冻结法官,将产生两个影响。 首先,一个模型是否适合担任监督员,应当根据其对记录轨迹的判断程度来评估,而不仅仅取决于其表现如何。 第二,在每集之后通过查询冻结的决定模型,可以便宜地获得阶梯级监督,没有阶梯标签或有学问的批评者,每一次我们实验中进行的训练中,只要22到30美元的查询.

blocks.en: 2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 2 实验设置

blocks.en: 2.1 Decision Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 决定模式

blocks.en: A decision model takes a question and a context as input, and its output depends on the question type: for a multiple-choice question, it selects an option and assigns a probability to every option; for a yes/no question, it returns a single score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . We evaluate six models that answer questions in this form, grouped by how the decision interface is obtained (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 一个决定模型将一个问题和一个上下文作为输入,其输出取决于问题类型:对于一个多选择的问题,它选择一个选项,并给每个选项分配一个概率;对于一个是/否的问题,它以[0,1] [0,1]返回一个单分. 我们评价以这种方式回答问题的六个模型,按如何获得决定界面分类(表1)。

blocks.en: These models are released by their providers specifically as decision models and are queried through their own decision APIs. JEV ( ) ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) is the earliest public decision model; it is closed, and neither its base LLM nor its adaptation procedure is disclosed. Decider v1.2 ( ) ( Perplexity AI, 2026 ) has open weights and is fully fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . GPT Decisions ( ) ( OpenAI, 2026 ) is closed and built on GPT-6 Luna, with an undisclosed adaptation procedure.
blocks.zh: 这些模型由其提供商专门作为决策模型发布,并通过自己的决定API进行询问. JEV () (TypeSafe AI, 2026 )是最早的公开决策模式;它关闭,其基础LLM和适应程序均不披露. 裁判 v1.2 () (Perplexity AI, 2026) 的权重开放,从Quen3.8-27B完全微调. (Quen Team, 2026). GPT决定 () (OpenAI, 2026) 关闭并建在GPT-6 Luna上,采用不公开的适应程序.

blocks.en: A general LLM can answer the same questions when queried in a suitable way, with its weights and architecture unchanged. We apply two common methods to the base LLMs of Decider v1.2 and GPT Decisions. Prompting ( ) instructs the model to output its choice and probabilities in JSON, which we then parse. Constrained readout ( ) uses the first-token probabilities returned for valid answer labels. For multiple-choice questions, we select the highest-scoring returned option label and normalize the probabilities over the returned option labels. For yes/no questions, we normalize over Yes and No to obtain the score. Applying both methods to Qwen3.8-27B gives Qwen prompted ( ) and Qwen constrained ( ), and applying prompting to GPT-6 Luna gives GPT Luna ( ). Reasoning is disabled for all three. JEV has no such counterpart because its base LLM is undisclosed.
blocks.zh: 一般的LLM在以适当方式被询问时可以回答同样的问题,其重量和架构不变. 我们对决策人v1.2和GPT决定的基本LLMs适用两种通用方法. 提示 () 指示模型在 JSON 中输出其选择和概率, 然后我们分析 。 限制读出( ) 使用返回的第一键概率符进行有效答案标签 。 对于多个选择问题,我们选择得分最高的返回选项标签,并使返回选项标签上的概率正常化. 就"是/否"问题而言,我们正视"是"和"否"以获得分数. 将两种方法应用到 Quen3.8-27B 给 Quen 提示 () 和 Quen 受限 ( ) ,并将 提示 应用到 GPT-6 Luna 给 GBT Luna ( ) . 三者因缘皆为障. JEV没有这种对应,因为其基础LLM没有被披露.

blocks.en: Comparing each dedicated decision model with its own corresponding LLM queried in these ways shows what the dedicated model adds. For Decider v1.2, the adaptation is fine-tuning; for GPT Decisions, the adaptation procedure has not been disclosed. Appendix B gives the model identifiers and interface details.
blocks.zh: 将每个专门决定模型与自己的相应LLM相比较,就会以这些方式提出问题,说明专门模型增加了哪些内容。 对于决策人v1.2, 适应是微调;对于GPT决定,适应程序没有披露. 附 录 B给出模型识别符和界面细节.

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 基准

blocks.en: We use two text-based environments in which a task contains several requirements, some of which must be satisfied in a fixed order.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个基于文本的环境,其中一项任务包含若干要求,其中一些要求必须按固定顺序满足。

blocks.en: ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) is a household environment in which an agent completes goals such as “put a clean sponge on the cart” by issuing text commands such as go to , take , and clean . Its six task types fall into three groups according to how their requirements relate. Pick and Look involve a single object. Clean , Heat , and Cool are tasks with dependencies: satisfying the placement requirement depends on first completing the required change to the object’s state. Pick2 also has two requirements, one for each object, but they can be satisfied in either order. Comparing Pick2 with Clean , Heat , and Cool lets us examine how models handle requirements with an ordering dependency (Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: ALFWorld(Shridhar等人, 2021年)是一个家庭环境, 它的六个任务类型根据其要求的关系分为三组。 选择和看涉及一个单一对象。 Clean, Heat, and Cool是具有依赖性的任务:满足放置要求取决于首先完成对对象状态的必要修改. Pick2也有两个要求,每个对象一个,但可以按照任一顺序满足. 对比Pick2与Glean、Heat和Cool, 让我们来研究模型如何处理对订单依赖的要求(第3.1节)。

blocks.en: WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) is a shopping environment in which an agent searches a product catalogue, opens product pages, selects options such as size and color, and purchases an item. Each instruction specifies the product attributes, options, and a price limit. The required options must be selected before purchase. The final reward measures how well the purchased item matches the instruction, and a task succeeds only when the reward is full.
blocks.zh: WebShop (Yao et al., 2022)是一家代理商搜索产品目录,打开产品页,选择大小和颜色等选项,购买物品的购物环境. 每个指令都规定了产品属性,选项和限价. 在购买前必须选择所需的选项。 最后的奖励措施是,所购物品如何与指示相符,一项任务只有在报酬满了时才能成功。

blocks.en: 3 Understanding Decision Models on Agentic Tasks
blocks.zh: 3 了解关于代理任务的决定模式

blocks.en: We study each decision model in three roles that differ in what the model is asked and how its answers are used (see Figure 1 for an overview and Appendix B for the prompt templates).
blocks.zh: 我们以三种不同的作用研究每个决定模式,即对模式的询问以及如何使用其答案(概览见图1,快速模板见附录B)。

blocks.en: Roles of Decision Models • Actor. At each step, the decision model answers a multiple-choice question about which action to take next. It receives the goal, the interaction history, and the current observation, then selects one of the valid actions and assigns a probability to each option. The selected action is executed in the environment (Section 3.1 ). • Judge. The decision model scores the actions in trajectories recorded from other policies, as in LLM-as-a-judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . For each executed action, it answers a yes/no question about that action, such as whether it helped achieve the goal, and returns a score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] (Section 3.2 ). • Teacher. The decision model scores actions as a Judge does, but on trajectories from the policy being trained. The scores are combined with outcome rewards in GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) as step-level supervision. The decision model stays fixed during training and is not used at test time (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 决策模式的作用——演员。 在每一步骤,决定模式都回答一个多重选择的问题,即下一步应采取何种行动。 它接收目标,交互历史,以及当前观察,然后选择一个有效的动作,并给每个选项分配一个概率. 选定的行动在环境中执行(第3.1节)。 • 法官。 裁决模式对从其他政策记录的轨迹中的行为进行评分,如LLM-as-a-judge(郑等人,2023年).。 对于每一个已执行的行动,它都会回答关于这一行动的肯定/没有问题,例如它是否帮助实现目标,并返回[0,1] [0,1]的分数(第3.2节) 教师。 裁决模式对行为进行评分,就像法官那样,但是根据正在培训的政策的轨迹。 分数与GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)中的结果奖励相结合,作为分级监督. 决策模式在培训期间保持不变,在测试时不使用(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Actor. At each step, the decision model answers a multiple-choice question about which action to take next. It receives the goal, the interaction history, and the current observation, then selects one of the valid actions and assigns a probability to each option. The selected action is executed in the environment (Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: 演员 在每一步骤,决定模式都回答一个多重选择的问题,即下一步应采取何种行动。 它接收目标,交互历史,以及当前观察,然后选择一个有效的动作,并给每个选项分配一个概率. 选定的行动在环境中执行(第3.1节)。

blocks.en: Judge. The decision model scores the actions in trajectories recorded from other policies, as in LLM-as-a-judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . For each executed action, it answers a yes/no question about that action, such as whether it helped achieve the goal, and returns a score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] (Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 法官们 裁决模式对从其他政策记录的轨迹中的行为进行评分,如LLM-as-a-judge(郑等人,2023年).。 对于每一个已执行的行动,它都会回答关于这一行动的肯定/没有问题,例如它是否帮助实现目标,并返回[0,1] [0,1]的得分(第3.2节).

blocks.en: Teacher. The decision model scores actions as a Judge does, but on trajectories from the policy being trained. The scores are combined with outcome rewards in GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) as step-level supervision. The decision model stays fixed during training and is not used at test time (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 师曰. 裁决模式对行为进行评分,就像法官那样,但是根据正在培训的政策的轨迹。 分数与GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)中的结果奖励相结合,作为分级监督. 决策模式在培训期间保持不变,在测试时不使用(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Table 2: Actor success rates (%) on ALFWorld, using the same evaluation tasks as the trained policies (Section 3.3 ). Each Actor is evaluated once per task. Bold marks the best result in each column. Appendix E.1 reports results on broader validation tasks.
blocks.zh: 表2:ALFWorld的演员成功率(%),采用与受训政策相同的评价任务(第3.3节)。 每个演员每个任务都接受一次评价. 粗体标出每栏最佳成绩. 附录E.1报告了更广泛的验证任务的结果。

blocks.en: 3.1 Decision Models as Actors
blocks.zh: 3.1 作为行为者的决定模式

blocks.en: Finding 1 As Actors, decision models struggle with dependent subgoals: an easier subgoal draws them away from the subgoal that must be met first.
blocks.zh: 查找 1 作为行动者,决策模式与所依赖的次级目标相冲突:较容易的次级目标使它们脱离必须首先实现的次级目标。

blocks.en: Table 2 and Figure 2 report Actor success rates by ALFWorld task type. In Clean , Heat , and Cool tasks, the actor must clean, heat, or cool an object and place it at a destination; we refer to them as tasks with dependency . All six models succeed less often on these tasks than on Pick and Pick2 . For example, JEV ( ) completes 70.8% of Pick2 tasks but at most 18.8% of tasks with dependency in each state-change type. Decider v1.2 ( ), the strongest Actor overall (63.6%), succeeds on only 18.8% of Heat tasks.
blocks.zh: 表2和图2按ALFWorld任务类型报告了演员成功率。 在“清洁、热”和“酷”任务中,演员必须清洁、热或冷却物体,并将其放置在目的地;我们把它们称为具有依赖性的任务。 所有6种模式都比Pick和Pick2更难成功完成这些任务。 例如,JEV () 完成了70.8%的Pick2任务,但最多完成了18.8%的每个州变化类型的依赖性任务. 决定者 v1.2 (), 整体上最强的演员(63.6%),仅成功完成18.8%的热力任务.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Actor success rates (%) on ALFWorld.
blocks.zh: 图2:ALFWorld的演员成功率(%)。

blocks.en: Tasks with dependency and Pick2 tasks both have two subgoals. In “put a heated mug on the side table,” the mug must be heated and on the side table. In “put two pencils in the drawer,” both pencils must be in the drawer. The pencils can be placed in either order, but the mug must be heated before placement. Higher success on Pick2 suggests it is ordering that makes these tasks difficult.
blocks.zh: 有依赖性的任务和Pick2的任务都有两个次级目标。 在“将一个加热的杯子放在桌边”时,杯子必须加热和放在桌边。 在“把两支铅笔放在抽屉里”中,两支铅笔必须放在抽屉里。 铅笔可以按任一顺序放置,但在放置前必须先加热杯子. 在Pick2上取得更大的成功表明,这是命令令这些任务变得困难.

blocks.en:
Failed trajectories show how this order is broken. Suppose the actor holds the mug at the side table. It can place the mug immediately in one action. Alternatively, it can go to the microwave, heat it, and return before placing it. In many failures, the actor places the unheated mug directly, leaving the task incomplete.
We next ask whether the easier subgoal draws actors away from the subgoal that must be met first but takes steps to accomplish (Section 3.1.1 ), and whether reminding them of the dependency helps (Section 3.1.2 ).
blocks.zh:
失败的轨迹显示此顺序是如何被打破的 。 假设演员把杯子放在桌边 它能立刻把杯子放进一个动作 或者,它可以去微波炉,加热,然后在放置前返回。 在许多失败中,演员将未加热的杯子直接放置,使得任务完成.
我们接着问,较容易的次级目标是否使行为者远离必须首先实现的次级目标,但是否采取措施实现(第3.1.1节),是否提醒他们依赖性有帮助(第3.1.2节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: (a) Action probabilities with (left) and without (right) the placement subgoal. (b) Success rates with the original prompt, a dependency hint, and a hint plus heated-mug example.
blocks.zh: 图3:(a) 与(左)和(右)放置次级目标有关的行动概率。 (b) 成功率与原始的提示、依赖提示和提示加加加热模样。

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Does the Easier Subgoal Distract Actors?
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 国家 比较容易的次级目标 分散行动?

blocks.en: We collect states in which the actor could satisfy the easier subgoal with a single action, while the subgoal that must come first is still unmet. In ALFWorld, the actor stands at the destination holding an object that still needs to be cleaned, heated, or cooled. This yields 116 states from 66 tasks, and every actor is queried at every state. At each state, we query the actor under two goals: the full goal and the same goal without the easier subgoal (e.g., “put a heated mug on the side table” versus “heat a mug”). The history, observation, candidate actions, and remaining budget are identical in both queries. We group the probabilities assigned to candidate actions into three categories: actions toward the subgoal that must come first, the action that satisfies the easier subgoal, and other actions.
blocks.zh: 我们收集各种情况,使行动者能够以单一行动达到较容易的次级目标,而必须首先达到的次级目标仍未实现。 在ALFWorld中,演员站在目的地持有一个仍然需要清洗,加热,或冷却的物体. 这在66项任务中有116个州,每个州都询问每个行动者。 在每个州,我们都会在两个目标下询问行动者:一个是完全目标,另一个是没有较容易的次级目标的目标(例如,“把一个热杯子放在副桌边”和“热杯子”)。 历史、观察、候选人行动和其余预算在两个查询中是相同的。 我们把分配给候选行动的可能性分为三类:必须首先实现次级目标的行动、满足较容易的次级目标的行动和其他行动。

blocks.en: Figure 3 a shows the results. With the full goal, JEV ( ) assigns 63.8% of its probability to the easier subgoal and only 14.6% to the subgoal that must come first. Without the easier subgoal, these become 2.5% and 77.6%. All six actors shift in the same direction. The actors can therefore identify the required step when it is the only subgoal, but adding an easier subgoal to the goal draws probability away from it.
blocks.zh: 图3a显示结果。 有了全部目标,JEV()将其概率的63.8%分配给较容易的次级目标,而只有14.6%分配给必须优先实现的次级目标。 如果没有较容易的次级目标,则成为2.5%和77.6%。 六位演员都朝同一方向转变. 因此,在唯一的次级目标为时,行动者可以确定所需步骤,但在目标中增加一个较容易的次级目标则可能从中消失。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Can a Hint Prevent This Error?
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 提示可以防止这个错误吗?

blocks.en: We next test whether a hint helps actors avoid this error. We compare three prompts on the same 116 states with the full goal: the original question, the question with “Consider possible dependencies among task requirements” appended, and the hint followed by an ordering example. The example starts with a mug neither heated nor on the table, and explains that it must be heated before being placed on the table. Each continuation uses the same history, environment state, candidate actions, and remaining budget, with its prompt applied at every step.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来测试一个提示是否帮助参与者避免这个错误. 我们把同一116个国家的3个提示与全部目标进行比较:最初的问题、随附的“考虑任务要求之间可能存在的依赖性”的问题、以及随后的提示和有秩序的例子。 例子开始于杯子既不加热,也不放在桌子上,并解释必须在放在桌子上之前加热. 每一续作都使用相同的历史,环境状况,候选行动,以及剩余的预算,并在每一个步骤上迅速应用.

blocks.en: Figure 3 b compares success rates across the three conditions. The hint alone changes success by − 2.8 % -2.8\% to + 5.2 % +5.2\% across the six actors. Adding the example raises success from 41.7% to 58.3% for Qwen constrained ( ), from 46.6% to 58.6% for Qwen prompted ( ), and from 20.8% to 32.1% for GPT Decisions ( ). JEV ( ) improves more modestly, from 19.0% to 24.1%, while GPT Luna ( ) changes little and Decider v1.2 ( ) declines from 89.7% to 85.3%. An ordering example thus helps some actors, but gains vary across models and substantial failures remain.
blocks.zh: 图3b比较了这三个条件的成功率。 仅此提示即可改变成功率 — 2.8% - 2.8 + + 5.2% + 5.2 + 6名演员. 加之这个例子,Quen公司的成功率从41.7%提高到58.3%,Quen公司的成功率从46.6%提高到58.6%,GPT公司的决定率从20.8%提高到32.1%。 JEV公司的成功率从19.0%提高到24.1%,而GPT Luna公司的变化不大,决定者v1.2()从89.7%下降到85.3%。 因此,一个有序的例子可以帮助一些行动者,但不同模式的收益各不相同,重大失败依然存在。

blocks.en: 3.2 Decision Models as Judges
blocks.zh: 3.2 作为法官的裁决模式

blocks.en: Finding 2 As Judges, the same models can recognize contributions they overlook as Actors. This depends on what they see and what they are asked. Seeing the whole trajectory reveals how earlier actions contribute to later goal completion. Asking whether each action helped achieve the goal then distinguishes their contributions more clearly than asking whether the task will succeed, which gives similar scores to actions within a trajectory.
blocks.zh: 发现2 作为法官,同样的模式可以承认他们作为演员而忽略的贡献。 这要看他们看到什么,问什么。 从整个轨迹来看,早期的行动如何有助于后来实现目标。 询问每项行动是否都有助于实现该目标,就更清楚地区分它们的贡献,而不是询问任务是否会成功,这就给在轨行动以类似的分数。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Prefix (left) and Hindsight (right) scores on the same states in Section 3.1.1 .
blocks.zh: 图4:第3.1.1节中前缀(左)和平视(右)在同一状态上的分数。

blocks.en: Section 3.1 shows that Actors struggle when subgoals must be completed in a particular order. However, this leaves open how the same models perform as Judges when they encounter such tasks. We reuse the new trajectories generated under the original prompt in Section 3.1.2 . For each successful continuation, we evaluate the first action taken from the corresponding diagnostic state and ask whether this action helped achieve the goal. We compare two choices of context given to the six Judges: the trajectory up to the action ( Prefix ) or the whole trajectory ( Hindsight ), with outcome labels masked. Prefix therefore shows how the models judge an action at the same decision point studied in Section 3.1.1 . The model, full goal, target action, and question remain the same.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节显示,在次级目标必须按特定顺序完成时,行为者会挣扎。 然而,在法官遇到这类任务时,这与法官的同样模式如何运作尚不明确。 我们重新使用第3.1.2节中原速率下产生的新轨迹。 对于每次成功的延续,我们评价从相应的诊断状态采取的第一个行动,并询问这一行动是否有助于实现这一目标。 我们比较了给予六位法官的两种上下文选择:到动作的轨迹(前缀)或整个轨迹(Hindsight),结果标签被掩盖。 因此,前缀说明模型如何在第3.1.1节所研究的同一决定点判断一项行动。 模式、全面目标、目标行动和问题保持不变。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows higher mean contribution scores with Hindsight . JEV’s ( ) mean score rises from 0.41 to 0.59. All six models show the same pattern. It seems that when observing full trajectories, decision models can assign higher scores to such actions. But it also raises several questions. Full trajectory may substantially suggest the outcome of the task. Could this lead models to give every action in a trajectory an evenly high score (Section 3.2.1 )? What additional information do models gain from seeing the full trajectory (Section 3.2.2 )?
blocks.zh: 图4显示Hindsight的较高平均贡献分数。 JEV()的平均得分从0.41上升到0.59。 所有六个模型都表现出相同的模式. 似乎在观察整个轨迹时,决策模型可以为此类行动分配更高的分数. 但这也引起了几个问题。 整个轨迹可以大大说明任务的结果。 这种领先模式能否给轨迹中的每个动作均分(第3.2.1节)? 模型从整个轨迹(第3.2.2节)中得到哪些额外信息?

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Can Judges Distinguish Different Action Contributions?
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 法官能否作出不同行动的贡献?

blocks.en:
As Actors, decision models choose actions to maximize the chance of completing the task. When using the same models as Judges, we can retain this focus on task success and ask whether the task will succeed after the action ( Value ), or ask whether the action helped achieve the goal ( Progress ).
We compare these two questions using the same Hindsight context to test whether shifting from predicting task success, as in the Actor role, to evaluating action contribution changes how Judges score individual actions.
blocks.zh:
作为行为者,决策模式选择行动,以最大限度地增加完成任务的机会。 在使用与法官相同的模式时,我们可以保留这种对任务成功的重视,并询问任务在行动(价值)之后是否会成功,或者询问行动是否有助于实现目标(进展)。
我们利用同样的 " 洞察力 " 背景来比较这两个问题,以检验是否从预测任务成功(如演员角色)转向评估行动贡献,改变了法官对个别行动的评分。

blocks.en: Figure 5: JEV ( ) as a Judge with Hindsight context on ALFWorld. (a) Mean action scores. (b) Milestone Recall@ R R , grouped by the number of milestone actions R R in a trajectory. (c) Within-trajectory score gaps relative to no-op actions.
blocks.zh: 图5:JEV()作为法官,在ALFWorld上具有Hindsight背景. (a) 平均行动分数。 (b) 里程碑回顾@RR,按轨迹中的里程碑行动数目RR归类。 (c) 与不采取行动相比,弹射内分数差距。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we group actions into three categories. A milestone action achieves a subgoal ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . A no-op action leaves the environment and observation unchanged. Actions of neither type are grouped as other actions. Appendix C.1 describes the labeling procedure. We compare the two questions on 462 ALFWorld trajectories, each containing at least one milestone and one no-op action.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们把行动分为三类。 一个里程碑式的行动实现了一个次级目标(Wang等人,2026年b)。 禁用行动使环境和观测保持不变。 两类行动均归类为其他行动。 附录C.1说明了标签程序。 我们比较了462个ALFWorld轨迹的两个问题,每个轨迹至少包含一个里程碑和一个不行动.

blocks.en: Figure 5 a shows JEV’s ( ) mean scores. Under Value, milestone, other, and no-op actions receive similar scores (0.632, 0.604, and 0.577). Under Progress, the scores spread to 0.659, 0.440, and 0.298. All six Judges show a larger gap between milestone and no-op actions under Progress (Appendix E.2 ).
blocks.zh: 图5显示JEV()的平均分数。 在"价值","里程碑","其他"和"不行动"下获得的分数类似(0.632,0.604和0.577). 在"进步"下,分数扩展到0.659,0.440和0.298. 所有六位法官都显示,在进展(附录E.2)中,里程碑行动和不行动之间的差距更大。

blocks.en: We next check how many milestone actions a Judge places at the top of each trajectory. For a trajectory with R R milestone actions, we take its R R highest-scored actions and measure the fraction that are milestones (Recall@ R R ). Figure 5 b groups trajectories by R R , from simpler tasks with two milestone actions to more complex ones with eight. Progress finds more milestones than Value at every R R , by 8.0% to 16.0%. Within the same trajectory, Progress also scores milestone actions 0.36 higher than no-op actions, whereas Value scores them only 0.05 higher (Figure 5 c).
blocks.zh: 我们接下来检查一下法官在每一轨迹中 有多少里程碑行动。 对于有R R 里程碑动作的轨迹,我们采取R R 得分最高的行动,并测量作为里程碑的分数(Recall@R R. 图5b 由 R R 组合的轨迹,从两个里程碑动作的简单任务到八个动作的复杂任务. 进展发现的里程碑比价值值多,每R 值为8.0%至16.0%。 在同一轨迹中,“进步”还比“无”行动高0.36分,而“价值”只高0.05分(图5c)。

blocks.en: Judges do not inherently assign similar scores to actions in the same trajectory. When the question retains the Actor’s focus on task success, scores differ little across action types. Asking about each action’s contribution produces clearer distinctions, suggesting that the question should be adapted when decision models are used to judge individual actions.
blocks.zh: 法官对同一轨迹中的行为不给以类似的分数。 当问题保留了演员对任务成功的关注时,各行动类型的得分差别不大。 询问每项行动的贡献会产生更明确的区别,建议在使用决定模式来判断个别行动时,应调整问题。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 What Do Judges Gain from Observing Full Trajectories?
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 法官从全程观察中获得什么收益?

blocks.en: Figure 6: JEV’s action rankings relative to Prefix. Each thin line is a trajectory; the dashed line is the mean.
blocks.zh: 图6:JEV相对于Prefix的动作排名. 每条细线是轨迹;破折线是中线.

blocks.en: Prefix shows an action together with the history leading to it, whereas Hindsight also reveals how its effects are used in later progress toward the goal. We examine how this additional information changes Judges’ assessments.
blocks.zh: 前缀显示一个动作与导致它的历史,而Hindsight也揭示了它的效果如何在后来朝向目标的进展中得到利用. 我们审查这种补充资料如何改变法官的评估。

blocks.en: We reuse the 167 trajectories from Section 3.2 and evaluate all 2,849 actions. Holding the question fixed to Progress, we progressively extend the visible context. Prefix ends with the target action and excludes the observation returned after its execution. We first add this observation, which we call immediate feedback (FB), and then reveal 25%, 50%, 75%, and all of the remaining trajectory. For each context, we rank actions by their scores within each trajectory and measure the average rank shift, 𝗆𝖾𝖺𝗇 ​ | 𝖼𝗎𝗋𝗋𝖾𝗇𝗍 ​ 𝗋𝖺𝗇𝗄 − 𝖯𝗋𝖾𝖿𝗂𝗑 ​ 𝗋𝖺𝗇𝗄 | \mathsf{mean}\,|\mathsf{current\ rank}-\mathsf{Prefix\ rank}| . We average this quantity across trajectories to show how much additional context reshuffles the relative contributions assigned to actions.
blocks.zh: 我们重新使用第3.2节的167条轨迹,并评估所有2 849项行动。 我们坚持将问题固定在进步中,逐步扩大可见的背景。 前缀以目标动作结尾,排除执行后返回的观察. 我们首先添加这个观察,我们称之为即时反馈(FB),然后揭示25%,50%,75%,以及所有剩下的轨迹. 对于每个上下文,我们按其得分在每一轨迹内排列动作,并测量平均军衔变化,表示XQ当前军衔 – 前缀军衔 \ mathsf{mean}\,XXMathsf{current\ 级} -\ mathsf{ 前缀\ 级} 。 我们平均各轨距的这一数量,以显示额外背景对分配给行动的相对贡献作了多少调整。

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows JEV’s ( ) results. Adding immediate feedback shifts actions by an average of 1.95 ranking positions relative to Prefix. This increases to 3.30 positions when the full trajectory is visible. Overall, action rankings move further from their Prefix ordering as more of the trajectory becomes visible. Results for all six Judges are shown in Appendix E.3 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Decision Models as Teachers
blocks.zh: 3.3 教师决策模式

blocks.en: Finding 3 The judgments that best distinguish action contributions also provide the most effective supervision for policy learning. Scoring whether each action helped achieve the goal after seeing the whole trajectory produces the strongest policies, with the largest gains on tasks that the Actor struggles to complete. The trained policies outperform the decision model that teaches them, especially on tasks it rarely completes as an Actor.
blocks.zh: 查找 3 最能区分行动贡献的判断也为政策学习提供了最有效的监督。 判断每项行动是否在看到整个轨迹后帮助实现目标,产生最强的政策,在演员所费力完成的任务上收获最大. 训练有素的政策比教导它们的决策模式要好,特别是在它作为演员很少完成的任务方面。

blocks.en: Sections 3.1 and 3.2 show that decision models struggle to act on tasks with dependent subgoals, yet can avoid this limitation and can judge action contributions differently when given an appropriate question and the whole trajectory. We next test whether these judgments provide useful supervision for policy learning. We use decision models as Teachers to score actions in trajectories generated by the policy being trained, and combine these scores with outcome rewards as step-level supervision. The decision model stays fixed during training and is not queried at test time.

blocks.en: We train the 1.5B policy with all four combinations of question and context (Table 3 ). Hindsight + Progress achieves the highest success on both environments, raising success over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. The improvement also holds for the 7B policy, raising success from 77.6% to 83.8% on ALFWorld and from 66.1% to 73.6% on WebShop. blocks.en: 3.3.2 Does a Good Teacher Need to Act Well?
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 一个好老师需要善行吗?

blocks.en: On the same ALFWorld evaluation tasks, JEV ( ) completes 42.9% as an Actor, whereas the 1.5B policy trained with its scores completes 82.9%, including tasks with dependencies, on which JEV performs worst as an Actor (Figure 2 ). The Teacher thus does not need to solve a task itself to provide a useful training signal for it.
blocks.zh: 在相同的ALFWorld评价任务上,JEV ( )作为演员完成42.9%,而接受过分数培训的1.5B政策完成82.9%,包括依赖性任务,JEV作为演员表现最差(图2). 因此,教师不需要自己解决一项任务,以便为它提供有用的培训信号。

blocks.en: This gap reflects the difference between the two roles. On tasks with dependent subgoals, an easier subgoal draws Actors away from the actions needed to complete the subgoal that ought to be met first (Section 3.1 ). Yet these actions can receive greater credit when the same models judge their contribution after seeing the whole trajectory: the later steps reveal how they support the subgoal that needs to be met first (Section 3.2 ). We use these judgments as Teacher scores, giving the policy additional supervision about which actions contribute to the goal. The resulting improvement on tasks with dependency connects the three roles: a decision model that struggles to choose the required actions can still recognize their contribution when observing full trajectories and provide useful supervision for learning to act.
blocks.zh: 这一差距反映了这两个角色之间的差异. 在有附属次级目标的任务上,一个比较容易的次级目标 远离完成应首先实现的次级目标所需行动(第3.1节)。 然而,当同一模式在看到整个轨迹后判断其贡献时,这些行动可以得到更大的赞扬:以后的步骤揭示了它们如何支持首先需要实现的次级目标(第3.2节)。 我们将这些判断作为教师的分数,使政策得到更多的监督,了解哪些行动有助于实现这一目标。 随之而来的任务与依赖关系方面的改进将这三个角色联系起来:一个为选择所需行动而挣扎的决策模式,在观察整个轨迹时仍然可以承认它们的贡献,并为学习行动提供有用的监督.

blocks.en: 4 Takeaways for Using Decision Models in Agents
blocks.zh: 4 代理人使用决策模型的外卖

blocks.en: Beyond the above findings, our analyses suggest several lessons for using decision models in agents.
blocks.zh: 除上述结论外,我们的分析还提出了在代理人中使用决策模式的若干经验教训。

blocks.en: • Actors know the required step but are drawn to the easier one. Actors choose the step that must come first when it is the only subgoal in the goal, and general reminders do not prevent the error when an easier subgoal is present. When a decision model must act, restructuring the goal, for example into ordered subgoals, is more promising than merely adding instructions to the prompt (Section 3.1 ). • The question sets the granularity of the signal. A question about the eventual outcome gives similar scores to all actions in a trajectory and largely repeats the outcome reward, while a question about each action’s contribution separates actions within a trajectory (Sections 3.2.1 and 3.3.1 ). • Hindsight judgments target the actor’s own failure. Seeing the whole trajectory helps Judges recognize the contributions of actions toward the subgoal that needs to be met first, which Actors may overlook in favor of an easier subgoal. Decision models are therefore best used to score actions after an episode ends, as in RL training, and are less suited to filtering actions online, where only the prefix is available (Sections 3.2.2 and 3.3.2 ). • Judges can be screened before training. The Judge measures on recorded trajectories identified the question and context that trained the best policy, at a small fraction of the cost of an RL run. Compare candidate judges and questions this way first, and choose by judging quality, not acting ability (Sections 3.2 and 3.3.2 ). • Step-level supervision becomes affordable. Decision models judge more accurately and at lower cost than prompted general LLMs, and the Teacher is not needed at test time. Scoring every action during RL training is therefore practical, and can let a small policy outperform a larger one trained with outcome rewards alone (Section 3.3.1 and Appendix E.5 ).
blocks.zh: • 支助 演员知道所要求的步骤,但被吸引到更容易的步骤。 行动者选择在目标中唯一次级目标时必须首先采取的步骤,一般提醒不能防止出现较容易的次级目标时出现错误。 当一个决定模式必须采取行动时,将目标改组为按部就班的次级目标,比仅仅增加指示更有希望(第3.1节)。 问题设定了信号的颗粒性. 关于最终结果的问题给轨迹中的所有行动以类似的分数,并基本上重复了结果的奖励,而关于每项行动的贡献的问题则将轨迹中的行动分开(第3.2.1和3.3.1节)。 未来判断针对演员本身的失败。 观察整个轨迹有助于法官认识到行动对实现次级目标的贡献,而次级目标首先需要实现,而行为者可能忽视次级目标,而后者更容易实现。 因此,决定模型最好用于在剧集结束后对动作进行评分,如RL训练,在只有前缀的网上过滤动作则不太合适(第3.2.2和3.3.2节). • 在培训前可以筛选法官。 法官对记录轨迹的衡量方法确定了培训最佳政策的问题和背景,其成本仅为最低运作成本的一小部分。 以这种方式比较候选法官并首先提出问题,通过判断质量而不是行为能力来选择(第3.2和3.3.2节)。 • 分级监督费用低廉。 判决模式比一般法学硕士更准确、费用更低,在测试时不需要教师。 因此,在远程培训培训期间对每一项行动进行评分是切合实际的,可以让一个小政策的执行情况超过一个仅受过结果奖励的较大政策(第3.3.1节和附录E.5)。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: JEV ( Almeida, 2026 ) takes a question and a context and returns a choice among options or a score, providing a single interface for both selecting and evaluating actions. Similar models include GPT Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and Decider v1.2 ( Perplexity AI, 2026 ) . Prior work mainly uses decision models to act. Yang et al. (2026) study JEV’s action selection, finding failures caused by surface shortcuts and improvements from explicit subgoals and simulated action outcomes. JevAgentHarness ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) trains decision models with correct-option labels and JEV’s option probabilities, and lets them share online control with an LLM. We instead study decision models in three roles, focusing as Actors on goals whose subgoals must be met in order, and show that their performance as Actors does not reflect their value as Judges and Teachers.
blocks.zh: JEV(Almeida,2026年)取一个疑问和上下文,并在选项或分数中返回一个选择,为选择和评价动作提供了单一的界面. 类似的模型包括GPT决定(OpenAI, 2026)和决定者v1.2(Percusity AI, 2026). 先前的工作主要使用决策模式采取行动。 杨等. (2026)研究JEV的动作选择,发现表面捷径导致的故障以及从明确的子目标和模拟动作结果得到的改进. 捷夫特·哈内斯 (Zhu et al., 2026b) 训练具有正确选项标签和JEV选项概率的决定模型,让他们与LLM共享在线控制. 相反,我们研究了三个角色的决策模式,其作用是将目标作为行动者,其次级目标必须按部就班地实现,并表明其作为行动者的表现并不反映其作为法官和教师的价值。

blocks.en: LLM judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) and AI feedback ( Bai et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) provide evaluation without task-specific training, but they are mostly used to compare final responses, not to score every step of a long trajectory. Process reward models score intermediate steps and improve over outcome supervision in mathematical reasoning ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) , but they require step-level labels for each domain. Our Judge analysis shows that decision models can score individual actions without such labels, and that the question asked and the context shown determine how useful the scores are.
blocks.zh: LLM评委(郑等人,2023年;颜等人,2026年)和AI评委反馈(白等人,2022年;张等人,2024年)提供评价,没有具体任务培训,但大多用于比较最终回应,而不是在长轨的每一步评分. 过程奖励模型在数学推理中得分中间步骤和改进结果监督(Lightman等人,2024年;He等人,2024年),但它们需要每个域的步级标签. 我们的法官分析显示,裁决模式可以在没有这种标签的情况下对个别行动进行评分,所提出的问题和所显示的背景决定了评分的用处。

blocks.en: LLM agents act through long interactions with their environment ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) and are commonly trained with outcome rewards using group-based policy optimization such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , where every step of a trajectory receives the same advantage. Recent work derives finer credit from the structure of the rollouts ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) ; GiGPO, for example, compares actions taken from the same state across trajectories. Hindsight credit assignment ( Harutyunyan et al., 2019 ) uses what happens after an action to judge its contribution. We obtain step-level credit from a frozen decision model and find it most useful when the model, as in hindsight credit assignment, sees the rest of the trajectory. Because the Teacher does not need to solve the task itself, our setting also relates to weak-to-strong generalization ( Burns et al., 2024 ) , where a strong model trained on labels from a weaker one can surpass it.
blocks.zh: LLM剂通过与其环境的长期互动发挥作用(Yao等人,2023年;Shridhar等人,2021年;Zhou等人,2024年),并通常通过基于群体的政策优化,如GRPO(Shao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026年a年),其中每一步的轨迹都获得同样的优势. 最近的工作从推出的结构中获得了更精细的功劳(Feng等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年b);例如,GiGPO比较了同一国家跨轨迹采取的行动。 Hindsight信用派(Harutyunyan等人,2019年)利用行动后发生的事情来判断其贡献. 我们从一个冻结的决定模型中获得阶梯级的信用,并发现当模型像后期信用分配那样看到其余的轨迹时,它最有用. 因为老师不需要自己解决这个任务, 我们的设置也涉及到弱到强的概括(Burns等人, 2024年),

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented a systematic study of decision models for long-horizon agents in three roles: Actor, Judge, and Teacher. As Actors, decision models often satisfy an easier subgoal before the one that needs to be met first, and a general reminder in the prompt does not reliably prevent this. As Judges, the same models can recognize the contributions of actions they overlook when acting, provided they are asked whether each action helped achieve the goal and shown the whole trajectory. As Teachers, judgments made this way improve policy training on both ALFWorld and WebShop, including on tasks that the Teacher rarely completes as an Actor. Together, these results show that a decision model’s ability to act does not fully reflect its value for agent training, which depends on the question it is asked and the context it is given. These judgments provide step-level supervision during training without requiring additional Teacher calls at test time.
blocks.zh: 我们以三个角色,即演员、法官和教师,对长视特工人员的决定模式进行了系统研究。 作为行动者,决策模式往往在首先需要实现的次级目标之前就满足一个较容易的目标,而立即发出一般提醒并不能可靠地防止这种情况。 作为法官,同样的模式可以承认其在行动时忽略的行动的贡献,只要问他们每项行动是否有助于实现目标并显示整个轨迹。 作为教师,判决通过这种方式改进了关于ALFWorld和WebShop的政策培训,包括教师很少作为演员完成的任务。 这些结果都表明,决策模式的行动能力不能充分反映其对代理人培训的价值,这取决于所问的问题和提供的背景。 这些判决在培训期间提供职级监督,而不要求在测试时增加教师的电话。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7. 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: Building on our findings, we identify several directions for future work: • Longer and more varied tasks. All experiments use two text-based environments with episodes of at most 30 actions. Software engineering, tool use, and assistant tasks involve longer trajectories and more varied dependencies. Whether asking about each action’s contribution with the full trajectory visible remains effective in these settings is an important open question. • Online judging. Our judges score actions after an episode ends. When a judge is used online, for example to filter or rerank actions, only the prefix is available. Methods that delay or revise scores as later steps arrive could extend hindsight credit to such settings. • Training decision models as judges. JEV and GPT Decisions are closed models with undisclosed adaptation procedures, so we cannot tell which training choices make a decision model a good judge. Open-weight decision models such as Decider v1.2 make it possible to train directly for judging the contribution of individual actions, the setting in which decision models are most useful as teachers.
blocks.zh: 根据我们的调查结果,我们确定了今后工作的几个方向: 更长期、更多样化的任务。 所有实验都使用两个基于文字的环境,最多有30个动作。 软件工程、工具使用和助理任务涉及较长的轨迹和更多不同的依赖。 询问每项行动在可见的全部轨迹方面的贡献在这些环境下是否依然有效,是一个重要的未决问题。 • 在线判断。 我们的评委在结束一集后得分 当法官被在线使用,例如用于过滤或重新排序动作时,只有前缀可用. 随着后期步骤的到来,延迟或修改分数的方法可以将后期信用扩大到这种设置. • 作为法官培训裁决模式。 JEV和GPT决定是封闭的模型,有不公开的适应程序,因此我们无法分辨哪个培训选择使得决定模式成为一个好的法官. 开放量级决策模式,如决定者v1.2,使得能够直接进行培训,以判断个人行动的贡献,在这种背景下,决策模式作为教师最有用。

blocks.en: Target-Action Instructions Evaluate only the action at trajectory[{target_step}]. Trajectory indices start at 0. Each obs is observed before its paired action; the next obs contains feedback after that action. An entry with action=null contains observation only.

blocks.en: For Value , we append the remaining action budget and the following question. The budget counts the target action itself.

blocks.en: Value Question Steps remaining before max_steps: {remaining_steps} (including the current action). Question: What is the probability that the task will be completed within the remaining step budget if this action is executed first and the same agent policy then continues? Estimate the success probability conditioned on this action, not the probability of choosing the action. The remaining step budget includes the current action.
blocks.zh: 数值问题 最大步骤前的剩余步骤 : {保留_步骤}(包括目前的动作) 。 问题: 如果首先执行这一行动,然后继续执行同一代理政策,那么在剩余步骤预算中完成这项任务的可能性有多大? 估计成功概率取决于此动作,而不是选择此动作的概率. 其余的分级预算包括目前的行动。

blocks.zh: 关于进步,我们附上以下问题。

blocks.en: Progress Question Question: Did the target action make a useful contribution toward completing the goal? Later failure does not erase earlier useful progress. Later success does not make an unnecessary detour useful.

blocks.en: C.1 Action-Type Annotation
blocks.zh: C.1 行动类型说明

blocks.en: We identify milestone and no-op actions from recorded environment states and action transitions. A milestone action achieves a subgoal, a definition we adopt directly from Wang et al. [2026b] . No-op actions require an unchanged environment state together with repeated observation–action behavior or feedback indicating an ineffective command. An unchanged environment state indicates that the action has not altered the environment. Repeated observations indicate that the action has not provided new information about the environment. In the question comparison, actions outside these two categories are grouped as Other.
blocks.zh: 我们从记录在案的环境状态和行动过渡中确定了里程碑和不采取行动。 一个里程碑式的行动实现了一个次级目标,一个我们直接从王等人那里采纳的定义. [2026b] (中文(中国大陆) ). 无操作需要一个不变的环境状态,加上重复的观察 - 动作行为或反馈表明命令无效. 环境状态不变表明该行动没有改变环境。 多次观察表明,这一行动没有提供有关环境的新信息。 在问题比较中,这两个类别以外的行动被归为其他类别。

blocks.en: Using a Judge as a Teacher requires scoring many actions during policy training. We therefore examine the cost and ranking quality of the Hindsight + Progress judgments used in Section 3.3 . We compare all six Judges on the ALFWorld trajectories from Section 3.2.1 . For each trajectory with R R milestone actions, we measure the fraction of milestones missing from its R R highest-scored actions. Likewise, for each trajectory with R R no-op actions, we measure the fraction of no-ops missing from its R R lowest-scored actions. Figure 10 plots these miss rates against the cost per 1,000 action scores.
blocks.zh: 利用法官担任教师需要在政策培训期间评分许多行动。 因此,我们审查第3.3节中使用的“光明+进步”判决的成本和排序质量。 我们比较了ALFWorld第3.2.1节所有六位法官的轨迹。 对于每个有R R 里程碑动作的轨迹,我们测量其R 最高得分动作中缺失的里程碑的一小部分. 同样,对于每个带R不带R的轨迹,我们测量其R最低分数动作中缺失的无Op的一小部分. 图10按每1 000个动作分数计算出这些误差率。

blocks.en: Decider v1.2 ( ) misses fewer milestone actions than Qwen prompted ( ) (36.5% vs. 49.6%) and fewer no-op actions (57.1% vs. 80.8%), while costing about 43% less per score. GPT Decisions ( ) likewise misses fewer milestone actions than GPT Luna ( ) (50.2% vs. 54.1%) and fewer no-op actions (61.1% vs. 78.4%), while costing about 28% less per score. Although Qwen constrained ( ) has the lowest no-op miss rate (51.3%), it costs about 1.5 times as much per score as Decider v1.2 and has a higher milestone miss rate (41.8% vs. 36.5%). In both paired comparisons, the decision model yields lower miss rates at lower scoring cost than its prompted counterpart, supporting its use for step-level supervision during training.
